notes.title: Patch Notes [March 7th 2024]
notes.notes:
[Items]
[list]
[*] Carrot:
[list]
[*] Changed required amount of jumps to add a stack, from 10 to 100.
[/list]
[/list]
[Misc]
[list]
[*] Added 'Snuffles'.
[*] Item pickup popup UI added.
[*] Stats are now shown on the End screen.
[*] Updated icons for all items.
[*] Soul Drainer now has attack sound.
[*] Hover UI for chests now show the correct icon for Soul Coins.
[*] All SFX are in the correct audio groups.
[*] Gloves now highlight when hovered.
[*] Item models added for:
[list]
[*] Strong Phone
[*] Staff of Anubis
[*] Ticket Printer
[*] Unitronix Ticket
[*] Xray Glasses
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 17th 2024]
notes.notes:
[Misc]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where nothing worked anymore after changing dimension.
[*] Unitronix Fusionizer model update.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 15th 2024]
notes.notes:
[Items]
[list]
[*] Xp Fueled Generator:
[list]
[*] New visual effect on healing aura.
[/list]
[*] Roboboy:
[list]
[*] Removed since it didn't do anything.
[/list]
[*] Stick:
[list]
[*] Buffed, changed kills needed per stack from 50 to 10.
[/list]
[*] Scimitar:
[list]
[*] New model.
[*] Doesn't search for a new target if it already has one.
[*] Added trail.
[/list]
[*] Crow:
[list]
[*] Doesn't search for a new target if it already has one.
[/list]
[*] Holy Cross:
[list]
[*] Added HUD element displaying cooldown.
[*] Shockwave effect added when it procs.
[/list]
[*] Lightning Talisman:
[list]
[*] Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.
[/list]
[*] Secret Item added.
[/list]
[Abilities]
[list]
[*] Bullet Ballet (Jack's Primary):
[list]
[*] Each consecutive shot is spaced 0.1 sec from each other.
[*] Cooldown for each charge is set to 0.5 sec.
[/list]
[/list]
[Misc]
[list]
[*] Zahir now spawns on the same level as the player, instead of preferring the lower level.
[*] Zipline: one can grab onto the line now as well.
[*] Removed a place where enemies could jump from one platform to another.
[*] New enemy wave spawn system.
[*] Added missing colliders to some environment objects.
[*] Pause screen can't be opened from end screen anymore.
[*] Spawn particle effect added to enemy gunners.
[*] Started implementation of game data collection, in a future update information of the previous run will be displayed on the end screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 13th 2024]
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Scimitar (item):
[list]
[*] Description matches the real values (said 10% when the actual value was 50%).
[*] Decreased attack interval from 5sec => 1sec.
[*] Decreased attack range from 10 units => 2 units.
[*] Increased enemy search range from 15 units => 20 units.
[*] Increased move speed from 10 => 20.
[*] Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.
[*] Doesn't get removed on Dimension change.
[/list]
[*] Crow (item):
[list]
[*] Damage dealt is now based on the owner's Damage stat (2x).
[*] Decreased attack interval 10 sec => 5 sec.
[*] Doesn't attack dead enemies anymore.
[*] Doesn't get removed on Dimension change.
[/list]
[*] Xray Glasses (item):
[list]
[*] Chest Beams spawn again on Dimension change.
[/list]
[*] Cursed Talisman of Greed (item):
[list]
[*] Removed, since it should do stuff that hasn't been implemented yet.
[/list]
[*] Tornado Havoc (ability):
[list]
[*] Damage multiplier increased from 1 => 2.
[*] Description gives more information now.
[/list]
[*] New item models added for :
[list]
[*] Unstable shield
[*] Rain cloud
[*] Piece of Bastion
[*] Mirror
[*] Broken Mirror
[*] Fortified Shield
[*] Double Edged Sword
[*] Cursed Idol
[*] Gravity Field
[*] Shocking Shield
[*] Stun Grenade
[/list]
[*] New enemy spawn waves implemented (one doesn't get swarmed 2 minutes into the game anymore).
[*] When player is under 25% HP, the damage overlay is constantly visible.
[*] All enemies give different amount of soul coins when killed.
[*] Enemy health now scales correctly with their levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [February 11th 2024]
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Stick (item):
[list]
[*] Shows stack amount on a HUD element.
[*] Instead of giving a stack each kill, now requires 50 kills for each stack.
[/list]
[*] Blue Pill (item) :
[list]
[*] Doesn't increase jump amount by 5% (which caused one to get double jump with only 1 blue pill in the inventory)
[/list]
[*] Tip of The Pyramid (item):
[list]
[*] Added Hud element for stack amount.
[*] Functions like intended now.
[/list]
[*] Staff of Anubis (item):
[list]
[*] Doesn't spam chat on proc anymore.
[/list]
[*] Mr Gugda (item):
[list]
[*] Doesn't think its a Mystic item anymore.
[/list]
[*] Deal Finder's Medallion (item):
[list]
[*] Removed from the playtest (did nothing in the current stage of the game).
[/list]
[*] Bullet Ballet (Jack's primary ability):
[list]
[*] Doesn't empty mag anymore if button is held.
[/list]
[*] On level up (both player and enemies) heal the difference of the new and old health amount.
[*] Difficulty scaling changes; made it harder in the later Dimensions.
[*] Zahir's level increases with the difficulty.
[*] Hovering over an item in the Unitronix and then leaving with the 'esc' key, now hides the tooltip.
[*] Completing an item set doesn't spam the chat anymore.
[/list]
